correct.evidence: Every date, item, question and reason of the twenty journeys is the same as the hand-checked fix 6 run, and the point 23 twins follow point 23a. But on J01, J03, J04, J07, J08, J10, J15 and J19, none with a petition, transfer and job-end rows turn unknown and lose their dates on the Timeline, while point 19 says those journeys stay unchanged.

sourced.evidence: verify, plain and engine_literals exit 0; the point 23 reading is in the capgap.petition_for_dso note and marked a reading; labels.ts and the pack plain words name the same kinds of date.

never_assumes.evidence: Missing starts, an o1 type and a missing filing day are asked, and old petitions keep a2.filed_on and the late-filing conflict. But the unknown row on J01's transfer says the DSO can tell a date that Duly asks the person for (mv1.contacted_new_dso_on).

inside_the_boundary.evidence: On petition cases the cap_gap.for_dso words, 'can change these dates', go on rows the petition cannot change: J19's 2021 and 2023 transfers and J14's 2024 job report.

secure.evidence: All journeys, 18 twins, probes and the three saved Onboarding cases return 200. An unknown choice value is asked, not taken in silence. No crash or stall found.

tested.evidence: 14 of 17 mutants are caught, including all four that point 25 names. The job-card filter on the final evaluation, the unemployment filter and window-only stage placement survive, and no web test covers an unknown row with no petition.

findings.title: unknown reaches stages no petition nulled; the Timeline drops their dates and adds the DSO line and petition words
findings.input: J01, J03, J04, J07, J08, J10, J15 and J19 through POST /v1/compute (clock 2026-09-29), none with a petition; J19 plus a petition with a start of 2026-06-09; J14
findings.what_happens: transfer.mv1/mv2 and opt_job_end.w1 go from current to unknown. web/src/lib/views/timeline.ts:138 then empties their items and meta and writes 'Your DSO can tell you these dates.' J01's transfer row loses 'from Jul 15, 2024' and its 2 items, while mv1.contacted_new_dso_on is asked of the person. With cap_gap.for_dso, the 2021 and 2023 transfers and J14's 2024 job report also carry 'Such a petition can change these dates'. This breaks point 19 ('every other journey is unchanged') and goes beyond point 22's scope.

findings.title: Three mutants survive: the job-card filter, the unemployment filter, and window-only placement
findings.input: J15 plus a petition filed 2020-04-01 with a start of 2020-10-01
findings.what_happens: HEAD dates Job B's final evaluation 2025-10-31 to 2025-11-10 and gives unemployment.total.a1 116. Making the :2041 filter true for any petition, or removing the filter at :2297, nulls them, and no acceptance, holdout or engine test fails. Turning off window placement at engine/path.py:663 turns J11 and J15 done job-end stages to unknown, and no test fails.

findings.title: The program-grace filter dates the program grace from the program's end even when OPT and STEM follow
findings.input: J19 plus a pending petition filed 2025-04-01 with a start of 2025-06-01
findings.what_happens: grace.p2 (2028-06-09 to 2028-08-07) is null and cap_gap.for_dso is given. This follows point 23a's words and states no wrong date. It is for the cap-gap round.

findings.title: fix6 note 1 still open: job-end reports dated after the card end
findings.what_happens: opt_job_end.report.w1 (J13) and stem_job_end.report.w2 (J14, 2026-07-15 to 07-25) are dated for jobs ending after the card, as in fix 6. This is for the cap-gap round.
